metadata.name: AppManager
metadata.summary: Install, manage, and update AppImage applications with desktop integration

content.value: AppManager is a desktop utility built with GTK 4 and Libadwaita designed to make installing, managing, and uninstalling AppImage packages seamless on Linux. It supports both SquashFS and DwarFS formats, providing a macOS-style drag-and-drop installation interface, automatic desktop integration, and bandwidth-efficient delta updates.
The application offers flexible installation workflows, allowing users to choose between self-contained portable execution and fully extracted installations without requiring FUSE.

items.value: Familiar macOS-style drag-and-drop installer window for newly opened packages
Automatic desktop integration extracting icons and application desktop entries
Isolated portable mode generating local configuration and home data folders
Background update checks and delta updates powered by zsync
Web link integration via custom URI schemes for verified one-click installations
Support for side-by-side installations of multiple application versions
